table.name: traces_null
table.comment: Trace 聚合物化视图的 Null 引擎输入表；接收变更记录并触发下游聚合，不持久保存行数据。

column.name: project_id
column.comment: Langfuse 项目标识，用于隔离和筛选项目数据。

column.name: id
column.comment: Trace 标识；由写入的 trace、observation 或 score 事件归并得到。

column.name: start_time
column.comment: 当前输入事件对应的 trace 起始时间。

column.name: end_time
column.comment: 当前输入事件对应的 trace 结束时间。

column.name: name
column.comment: Trace 名称；本输入表中通常为空，由其他数据源补充。

column.name: metadata
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的 trace 元数据。

column.name: user_id
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的用户标识。

column.name: session_id
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的会话标识。

column.name: environment
column.comment: 当前输入事件所属环境。

column.name: tags
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的 trace 标签。

column.name: version
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的应用版本。

column.name: release
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的应用发布版本。

column.name: bookmarked
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的收藏状态；空值表示不覆盖已有值。

column.name: public
column.comment: 当前输入事件携带的公开状态；空值表示不覆盖已有值。

column.name: observation_ids
column.comment: 当前事件带来的 observation 标识，供聚合表去重合并。

column.name: score_ids
column.comment: 当前事件带来的 score 标识，供聚合表去重合并。

column.name: cost_details
column.comment: 当前事件带来的费用增量映射。

column.name: usage_details
column.comment: 当前事件带来的用量增量映射。

column.name: input
column.comment: 当前事件携带的非空输入内容；空字符串不会覆盖聚合结果。

column.name: output
column.comment: 当前事件携带的非空输出内容；空字符串不会覆盖聚合结果。

column.name: created_at
column.comment: 该记录首次创建时间。

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: 该记录最近一次业务更新时间。

column.name: event_ts
column.comment: 记录变更版本时间，用于 ReplacingMergeTree 选择较新的版本。

view.name: project_environments_traces_mv
view.query: SELECT project_id, groupUniqArray(environment) AS environments FROM traces GROUP BY project_id

view.name: project_environments_observations_mv
view.query: SELECT project_id, groupUniqArray(environment) AS environments FROM observations GROUP BY project_id

view.name: project_environments_scores_mv
view.query: SELECT project_id, groupUniqArray(environment) AS environments FROM scores GROUP BY project_id

view.name: analytics_traces
view.query: SELECT project_id, toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS hour, uniq(id) AS countTraces, max(user_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasUsers, max(session_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasSessions, max(if(environment != 'default', 1, 0)) AS hasEnvironments, max(length(tags) > 0) AS hasTags FROM traces WHERE toStartOfHour(timestamp) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), 1)) GROUP BY project_id, hour

view.name: analytics_observations
view.query: SELECT project_id, type, toStartOfHour(start_time) AS hour, uniq(id) AS countObservations, max(level != 'DEFAULT') AS hasLevel, max(provided_model_name IS NOT NULL) AS hasProvidedModelName, max(length(provided_usage_details) > 0) AS hasProvidedUsageDetails, max(length(provided_cost_details) > 0) AS hasProvidedCostDetails, max(prompt_name IS NOT NULL) AS hasPromptName FROM observations WHERE toStartOfHour(start_time) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), 1)) GROUP BY project_id, type, hour

view.name: analytics_scores
view.query: SELECT project_id, toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS hour, uniq(id) AS countScores, max(source = 'ANNOTATION') AS hasAnnotation, max(source = 'API') AS hasApi, max(source = 'EVAL') AS hasEval, max(observation_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasObservationScore, max(session_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasSessionScore, max(dataset_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasDatasetRunScore, max(data_type = 'BOOLEAN') AS hasBoolScore, max(data_type = 'NUMERIC') AS hasNumericScore, max(data_type = 'CATEGORICAL') AS hasCategoricalScore, max(comment IS NOT NULL) AS hasComment FROM scores WHERE toStartOfHour(timestamp) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), 1)) GROUP BY project_id, hour

view.name: traces_all_amt_mv
view.query:
SELECT -- Identifiers tn.project_id as project_id, tn.id as id, min(tn.start_time) as timestamp, -- Backward compatibility: redundant with start_time min(tn.start_time) as start_time, max(coalesce(tn.end_time, tn.start_time)) as end_time, anyLast(tn.name) as name,
-- Metadata properties maxMap(tn.metadata) as metadata, anyLast(tn.user_id) as user_id, anyLast(tn.session_id) as session_id, anyLast(tn.environment) as environment, groupUniqArrayArray(tn.tags) as tags, anyLast(tn.version) as version, anyLast(tn.release) as release,
-- UI properties argMaxState(tn.bookmarked, if(tn.bookmarked is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64(0, 3))) as bookmarked, argMaxState(tn.public, if(tn.public is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64(0, 3))) as public,
-- Aggregations -- DO NOT USE groupUniqArrayArray(tn.observation_ids) as observation_ids, groupUniqArrayArray(tn.score_ids) as score_ids, sumMap(tn.cost_details) as cost_details, sumMap(tn.usage_details) as usage_details,
-- Input/Output argMaxState(tn.input, if(tn.input <> '', tn.event_ts, toDateTime64(0, 3))) as input, argMaxState(tn.output, if(tn.output <> '', tn.event_ts, toDateTime64(0, 3))) as output,
min(tn.created_at) as created_at, max(tn.updated_at) as updated_at FROM traces_null tn GROUP BY project_id, id
